name: tower-web
description: 塔台 · Tower Web Edition (Local-First Proxy Subscription & Rule Manager)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(0); });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
